name: Black Mirror
description: Twisted tales run wild in this mind-bending anthology series that reveals humanity's worst traits, greatest innovations and more.

videos.title: The National Anthem
videos.overview: Prime Minister Michael Callow faces a shocking dilemma when Princess Susannah, a much-loved member of the Royal Family, is kidnapped.

videos.title: Fifteen Million Merits
videos.overview: After failing to impress the judges on a singing competition show, a woman must either perform degrading acts or return to a slave-like existence.

videos.title: The Entire History of You
videos.overview: In the near future, everyone has access to a memory implant that records everything humans do, see and hear.

videos.title: Be Right Back
videos.overview: After learning about a new service that lets people stay in touch with the deceased, a lonely, grieving Martha reconnects with her late lover.

videos.title: White Bear
videos.overview: Victoria wakes up and cannot remember anything about her life. Everyone she encounters refuses to communicate with her.

videos.title: The Waldo Moment
videos.overview: A failed comedian who voices a popular cartoon bear named Waldo finds himself mixing in politics when TV executives want Waldo to run for office.

videos.title: White Christmas
videos.overview: In a mysterious and remote snowy outpost, Matt and Potter share a Christmas meal together, swapping creepy tales of their earlier lives in the outside world.

videos.title: Nosedive
videos.overview: A woman desperate to boost her social media score hits the jackpot when she's invited to a swanky wedding. But the trip doesn't go as planned.

videos.title: Playtest
videos.overview: An American traveler short on cash signs up to test a revolutionary new gaming system, only to discover the thrills are a little too real.

videos.title: Shut Up and Dance
videos.overview: After a virus infects his laptop, a teen faces a daunting choice: carry out orders delivered by text message, or risk having intimate secrets exposed.

videos.title: San Junipero
videos.overview: In a seaside town in 1987, a shy young woman and an outgoing party girl strike up a powerful bond that seems to defy the laws of space and time.

videos.title: Men Against Fire
videos.overview: After his first battle with an elusive enemy, a soldier begins experiencing unfamiliar sensations and strange technical glitches.

videos.title: Hated in the Nation
videos.overview: The death of a journalist at the center of a social media firestorm leads a veteran detective and her tech-savvy apprentice to a chilling discovery.

videos.title: USS Callister
videos.overview: Capt. Robert Daly presides over his crew with wisdom and courage. But a new recruit will soon discover nothing on this spaceship is what it seems.

videos.title: Arkangel
videos.overview: Worried about her daughter's safety, single mom Marie signs up for a cutting-edge device that monitors the girl's whereabouts -- and much more.

videos.title: Crocodile
videos.overview: Architect Mia scrambles to keep a dark secret under wraps, while insurance investigator Shazia harvests people's memories of a nearby accident scene.

videos.title: Hang the DJ
videos.overview: Paired up by a dating program that puts an expiration date on all relationships, Frank and Amy soon begin to question the system's logic.

videos.title: Metalhead
videos.overview: At an abandoned warehouse, scavengers searching for supplies encounter a ruthless foe and flee for their lives through a bleak wasteland.

videos.title: Black Museum
videos.overview: On a dusty stretch of highway, a traveler stumbles across a museum that boasts rare criminal artifacts -- and a disturbing main attraction.

videos.title: Striking Vipers
videos.overview: When old college friends Danny and Karl reconnect in a VR version of their favorite video game, the late-night sessions yield an unexpected discovery.

videos.title: Smithereens
videos.overview: A London rideshare driver ignites an international crisis when he kidnaps a worker from a social media company.

videos.title: Rachel, Jack and Ashley Too
videos.overview: A lonely teen becomes obsessed with a robot doll based on her pop star idol, Ashley O - just as the real Ashley's life begins to unravel.

videos.title: Joan Is Awful
videos.overview: An average woman discovers a global streaming service has adapted her daily life — and her secrets — into a drama starring A-list actress Salma Hayek.

videos.title: Loch Henry
videos.overview: While filming a nature documentary in a sleepy Scottish town, a young couple catches wind of a juicy local story with ties to shocking past events.

videos.title: Beyond the Sea
videos.overview: In an alternative 1969, two astronauts on a perilous high-tech space mission grapple with the fallout of an unfathomable tragedy back on Earth.

videos.title: Mazey Day
videos.overview: A troubled Hollywood starlet goes to great lengths to escape packs of invasive paparazzi as she deals with the aftermath of a hit-and-run.

videos.title: Demon 79
videos.overview: Northern England, 1979. A meek sales assistant discovers she must commit terrible acts to prevent an imminent disaster.

videos.title: Common People
videos.overview: When a teacher is left fighting for her life, her doting husband signs her up for a high-tech system that keeps her alive — but at a cost.

videos.title: Bête Noire
videos.overview: A young woman is unnerved when an old acquaintance joins the company she works at — especially as there's something odd about her that only she can see.

videos.title: Hotel Reverie
videos.overview: A high-tech remake of a classic film sends its A-list star into another dimension, where she must stick to the script if she ever wants to make it home.

videos.title: Plaything
videos.overview: In a near-future London, an eccentric murder suspect is linked to an unusual video game from the '90s — which hosts a society of digital life forms.

videos.title: Eulogy
videos.overview: An isolated man is introduced to a groundbreaking system that allows users to step inside old photos — stirring powerful emotions in the process.

videos.title: USS Callister: Into Infinity
videos.overview: Nanette Cole and the crew of the USS Callister are stranded in an infinite virtual universe, fighting for survival against 30 million players.

awards: Won 6 Primetime Emmys. 48 wins & 186 nominations total
